what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Honduras in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 141214 Honduran asylum seekers in the United States, 83.8% of all asylum seekers from Honduras.
Refugees from Honduras, a separate group, live mostly in Mexico and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Honduras, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1044 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 164784, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.
The data shows large changes from year to year between 2012 and 2017.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals, and there is no breakdown by gender or age for this group.
